items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And Valentino. You heard of him? No, I don't think so. Paul Kidd Valentin. Well, he studied. He specialized in trumpet... But he was a solo Cornelis. And I'm telling you, he was that.

ctx.x: I know what he did. He's mouthpiece along. And all you had to do is put through your ear there and you could recognize he was tonguing that very same piece. Just the mouthpiece along. Just with the mouthpiece along. To show you how much intonation that he had. Yeah. Well, he had a beautiful tone. Now, another person that had a nice tone was Charlie Dublé. He was before my time. And I remember him because when I first just got to be a friend when he died. And this is Jean-Jacques. And Valentino. You heard of him?…
I've heard of one clarinetist, I think, by that name. No, no, not that. No, no, no. I don't know.
